IpoOverride.title: IpoOverride
IpoOverride.description: Admin-managed manual correction, custom IPO addition, or hidden suppression overlay applied on top of automatic live IPO feeds.

targetIpoId.description: Stable identifier of the IPO being overridden or created.

normalizedKey.description: Normalized company matching key used to merge with live scraped feeds.

companyName.description: Display company name of the IPO.

published.description: True when active and readable by all app clients.

customIpo.description: True when this IPO was manually created from scratch by the admin.

hidden.description: True to suppress this IPO from the public app catalog.

meta.description: Nested map containing shortCode, sector, boardType, exchange, status, and overview.

schedule.description: Nested map containing openDate, closeDate, allotmentDate, and listingDate.

pricing.description: Nested map containing priceLow, priceHigh, faceValue, lotSize, issueSizeCr, freshIssueCr, ofsCr, gmpRupees, and kostakRupees.

subscription.description: Nested map containing qibSubX, bNiiSubX, sNiiSubX, retailSubX, employeeSubX, and totalSubX.

registrar.description: Nested map containing registrarName and registrarUrl.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when override was created (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when override was last modified (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

AdminProfile.title: AdminProfile
AdminProfile.description: Private profile document for the authorized Admin Dashboard operator.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the authorized admin.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin profile was created (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

lastActiveAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest admin dashboard activity (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private per-user investor profile storing customizable investor details, synced IPO watchlist IDs, and theme/alert preferences. Strictly isolated to the signed-in user UID.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user (immutable).

displayName.description: User-editable investor display name (1 to 80 characters).

bio.description: Optional short investor note or bio (max 240 characters).

bookmarkedIpoIds.description: List of bookmarked IPO identifiers synced across devices (max 200 items).

preferences.description: Nested map containing themePreference, compactCards, notifyNewIpo, notifyOpenIpo, notifyAllotment, and notifyNewsAlerts.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when user profile was created (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when user profile was last updated (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

IpoAdminNote.title: IpoAdminNote
IpoAdminNote.description: Private admin-only internal audit note associated with an IPO override. Strictly inaccessible to non-admin clients.

targetIpoId.description: Identifier of the associated IPO override.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin note was last updated (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/ipo_overrides/{overrideId}.description: Published manual IPO overrides, custom IPO entries, and hidden IPO suppressions managed by the authorized admin.

/ipo_admin_notes/{overrideId}.description: Private admin-only internal notes linked by overrideId; readable and writable only by the authorized admin.

/admin_profiles/{userId}.description: Private admin operator profile isolated strictly to the authorized admin UID.

/user_profiles/{userId}.description: Private investor profile isolated strictly to the authenticated user's own UID.
